cs.t: I use the Corsair K70 Lux keyboard, with red mecanical switches. When working on my work's mac, I use a dell KB216 (much more silent, while still comfortable)
cs.th: Ask HN: What keyboard do you use?

cs.t: I do not see any rational argument for a Model M. I started on a PC then to XT, then to AT... I had two Model Ms and a clone model M. I had a choice of over 200 keyboards... I chose the G101 -> $31. It has the right feel for me, and its very quiet, I haul it around with my ASUS ROG laptop. At the desktop, I am using a white Dell KB216. Very light, and easy to clean.
cs.th: Ask HN: IBM Model M Keyboard Alternative?
